document.about: PLOS ONE article (CC BY). Its first page sets the journal's `PLOS ONE` banner as a picture over the article's title; an OCR engine reads the banner's words, set larger than the title.

notes: 2026-11-26: the banner's words, read by OCR in its picture, were the document's title, and the article's title was text. The stored reading is the built-in engine's of the banner's crop on page 1: `fdoc dev render-routed --ocr-regions --stored-resolution`, then `fdoc ocr --models`.
2026-11-26 (#455): a title is a `doco:Title` only where it is sure, its evidence naming how (`metadata`, `outline`, `type`); the title's checks look for the type, not the evidence.

checks.issue: The journal's banner read by OCR was the document's title.
The article's title was a paragraph under the banner.

element.text: Application of machine learning algorithms for multiparametric MRI-based evaluation of murine colitis
